text:
### Observed differences

- The order between the activity group A19/A20/A25 and A26/A27 reversed. Earlier, when they appeared in the same case, A26 or A27 came first almost always (for example, A26 before A19 in about 31 in 100 cases, A19 before A26 in about 0); in the later window the group comes first almost always (A19 before A26 in about 35 in 100, A26 before A19 in 0), with the same reversal for A20 and A25 against A26 and A27. The group's participation stayed similar (about 31–37 in 100 cases in both windows), so this is an order change, not a frequency change. [REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010]
- The group's successors changed almost completely. Earlier, A19, A20 and A25 each led mainly to A28 or A32 (roughly 45–56 in 100 outgoing transitions each); in the later window they lead to A26 in about 96–100 in 100 transitions. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004]
- The late segment no longer passes through the group: A27 earlier split its outgoing transitions about half to A28 and half to A19/A20/A25, and now leads to A28 in about 98 in 100; A28 earlier split about half to A32 and half back to the group, and now leads to A32 in about 99 in 100. [DIR005, DIR006]
- A08 occurs in about 30 in 100 cases in the later window, up from about 13, and appears earlier and more consistently (median position about 0.53 to about 0.29 of the trace). Its outgoing transitions, earlier spread over many successors (A16, A26, A15 and A49 at about 14 in 100 each), now go mainly to A19 (about 38 in 100), A20 (about 29) and A25 (about 21). A08 also moved from mixed ordering to a fixed order before A26, A27, A28 and A32 (A08 first in about 27 in 100 co-occurring cases, versus about 6 before with both orders similar). [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004]
- A45 now feeds this early part: earlier it led to A26 in about 92 in 100 outgoing transitions; in the later window it leads to A08, A19, A20 and A25 at roughly 23–26 in 100 each. [DIR007]
- Minor: A26 and A27, present in every case in both windows, sit slightly later (median position about 0.30 to 0.34 for A26, 0.56 to 0.59 for A27); routing from A48 and A50 is essentially unchanged (A48 to A49 about 89 to 99 in 100; A50 to A51 about 89 to 98 in 100). [POS005, POS006, DIR008, DIR009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the activities A19, A20 and A25, which earlier ran late in the case — after A26 and A27, flowing into A28 or A32 — now run early, before A26: in the later window they are entered mainly from A08 (whose participation roughly doubled, from about 13 to about 30 in 100 cases) and A45, and are followed almost exclusively by A26, while the late route now runs from A27 to A28 to A32 without the group. [REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, OCC001, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004]

Supporting signs: the order change is shown directly by the relation items, with co-occurrence levels for the group against A26/A27 roughly stable, so the reversal is not a participation artifact; the direction profiles show near-complete successor replacement on substantial observation counts (about 58–73 outgoing transitions per source in the later window); the position distributions shift consistently with the new order; and the screening produced 26 qualifying control-flow items against roughly 0.6 expected if nothing had changed, so the pattern as a whole is far beyond what random re-splits of stable behaviour produce. [REL005, REL007, REL009, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS002, POS003, POS004]

Limitations: the many items largely describe one underlying restructuring rather than independent confirmations; the position measures use event positions, so the "earlier" reading rests on the order relations; and the evidence cannot rule out that both orderings already existed as rare variants, with the windows capturing a shift in the mix of variants rather than a change to a single behaviour. [REL005, REL009, POS002, DIR002]

Other differences: A26 and A27 each sit slightly later in the later window (median position up about 0.03–0.04), and routing from A48 and A50 is essentially unchanged. [POS005, POS006, DIR008, DIR009]
